name: Natsuiro Sagittarius Gaiden Ayato-kyun no Otoko no Ko Nikki
original_name: 夏色さじたりうす 外伝 綾人きゅんのおとこの娘日記
source:
Ever since he started noticing her during their stay in the dormitory, the protagonist can’t get her out of his head. To clear his mind and think things through, he decides to stay behind at the dorm and take up a part-time job at a nearby café.

But then… she decides to stay behind and work there too. He’s thrilled—and a little panicked. To make matters worse, she looks way too good in the waitress uniform… Ahh, he can’t take it anymore!

Before he knows it, he’s hugging her, kissing her… and they spend the whole night passionately confirming their feelings for each other.

Oh, and there’s one little twist: she is actually his former best friend, Oniwa Ayato—and Ayato is 100% a boy.

So, this story is all about Ayato’s happy, blush-worthy diary as a boy who’s just a little… different. ♪

[Translated from [url=http://www.bloomhandle.jp/comi76/ayato.html]the official website[/url]]
